steps.name: Secret of the Warehouse (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Vina] in “Dorothy Village” and report the quest to [Mandarava] in “Oscar Road.”

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Nyahaaam.
(Bina yawns and makes eye contact with the approaching Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Nyang. hello.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Bina, did you sleep well?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Nyahaaam. I slept well, but I kept yawning because I was sleepy. I guess it's because it's a cat.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Come to think of it, Kairos was always sleeping too...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When can I see the concert in which Bina participates?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Hehe, I don't know. You can always see them practicing while struggling, but I don't know much about concerts.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: It hasn’t been long since I practiced with the ensemble. However, I also received compliments saying that I have improved a lot recently.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where do you practice?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Enter the Munchkin warehouse and it’s right in front of you. If you go a little further, you get lost.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Nyahahaha. If you've just been in town, you might not know.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: The Munchkin warehouse is so big that you can get lost in it. See that teapot-shaped building at the end?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That building is really pretty, is it a warehouse?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. Although it looks small at first glance, it is a very spacious warehouse inside. I could barely stop Leti from going in.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Has Letty become friends with Bina just now...?)

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: I kept going inside to run errands for my mom and was finally rescued.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard the spirit and the munchkin clan came out and came in. Are they okay?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. I find that fascinating too. I really know every nook and cranny of that large warehouse.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: But what were you doing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was wandering around wondering if there were any interesting stories related to the village.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: In that case, I will do what you asked and tell you. We need to put the sleeping Mandrake in the warehouse, bathed in the energy of the moon... … .

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: I have to put it in... .

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Wow. Hawk, mandrake... . Where have you been?
(Bina’s face turns pale for a moment.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rain?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: %s, what should I do? What should I do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Calm down and talk.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Happy Hawk, Mandrake is gone. Hunyaaang.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: It is a rare herb that is also used as a magic ingredient. Before storing it in the warehouse, it is left outside to dry on a day with good moonlight.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: I named it Happy Mandrake because it fell asleep happily after seeing the moonlight... .

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: That's gone... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not like the herbs have anything to do with it.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: No, that's right. People who really have magical powers just run away even though they don't even have feet.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Nya… . I have to find it before my mom finds out... .

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. Hey %s. Since this has come to this, can you please do me a favor?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Please find a happy Mandrake. I'll take a look around the village, and Adventurer will take you along the road... .

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: I, I, I will tell you the Munchkin Warehouse ghost story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ghost story?)

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Nyahahaha. After all, if it's an interesting story, it's a ghost story!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It’s a ghost story… . All I have to do is go out onto the road and find the Mandrake, right?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Yes… . Everyone knows that Mandarava is on the road, so if I tell my story, they will help me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. But this… It's definitely a secret from Glinda, right?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: It's a secret from mom. Thank you, Adventurer. Meow. If you find it, come here.
(Meanwhile, Bina, who is fully asleep, jumps on top of the cat-shaped house and looks around. However, she lowers her head to see if she does not see the mandrake she is looking for.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don’t think there is one in town… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since I can't just rest, let's go out on the road for a little while.

steps.name: Secret of the Warehouse (2)
steps.objective: After talking to [Mandarava] in “Oscar Road,” defeat the monsters in “Oscar Road” to obtain <Happy Mandrake>. Then report to [Vina] in “Dorothy Village.”

lines.text: (While wandering down the street, my steps stop at the place where I first met Glinda.)
(Nothing is still visible between the trees where the emerald light had flowed. Instead, in front of it is a mandarava lying face down, looking at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Ha. It's warm. After all, sunlight is best for plants. Because it's the best.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you been playing again?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I'm all about playing and resting. Oh, no. Work hard and rest. Look at this. I found a good herb.
(Mandarava opens the zipper and takes out several herbs inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I'm just saying I tried it, but it looks like I got stabbed a lot.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I am an innocent spirit! But why did you come out of town? As long as you stay in the village, don't go out if possible.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Wait a minute. you.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I think something is wrong with you, right? Is that correct?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have a favor to ask from Bina.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I wondered if Mandrake had escaped again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does that happen often? That's it anyway... .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Occasionally an unusual mandrake escapes. Usually, Glynda, Vina, and Runo are caught in my line and go back.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: But yesterday, that thing wasn't an unusual herb.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know any medicinal herbs?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: We talked under the moonlight. He told me not to worry too much as it would be good medicine if I fell asleep by receiving the energy of the moon.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: As a senior herbalist, I once said that the herbal medicine life is like that... . hmm.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You were the culprit. It's like they pushed me to escape.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: That herb is a happy mandrake. You're smiling. A smiling face is said to be happy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I talk to Iris about things like spirit management?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: You are too much. I wish you all the best like this. I was wrong. The goddess is a secret.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I will find a happy mandrake like you. No, I will definitely find it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since it's a herb spirit, you'll be able to find it quickly, right?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: If you don't want to get scolded by Glinda, you can find it quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you didn't want to get scolded, you should have behaved well.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Haven’t you been like that too? This is a case where the result is twisted even though it was not intended. That's exactly the case now.
(With those words, Mandarava flies and lands on %s's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Don't be stupid. You can't just stay like this. You and I are happy mandrake catching. Ah, there it is. excuse me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like I have something to ride... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (First of all, we need to find a happy Mandrake, so shall we do as Mandarava says...?)

steps.name: Secret of the Warehouse (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Vina] in “Dorothy Village” and defeat [Bunny Bunny Luceria] in “Munchkin Warehouse” to obtain <Flower Stone>. Then, return to [Vina] in “Dorothy Village” and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow… . doesn't exist… .

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Mom won't scold me for something like this. No, you will be scolded. What should I do? This is what life is all about. Bina, cheer up. uh?
(Vina sees Adventurer carrying it from afar and her eyes light up.)

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Oooooh!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Bina, here is the herb I was talking about.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Thank you! Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mandarava helped me find it. The day before, he said something to Yakcho that he was a senior.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: %s, shh… .

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Only. all. la. bar.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. How many times have I told you not to act like a senior to the herb since you are a spirit?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Thirteen times?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Where did all the thirteen Mandrake who heard that story go?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Everyone ran away and hid… … .

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: There is no new cotton for a while. Meow.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Bina, this is shameful.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Would you like to hold on without putting cotton in it? Do you want to get scolded by your mom?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Ah, okay. Eh. Bina resembles Glinda's daughter in some ways.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: What did you say? Mandarava?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: … sorry. I will be careful from next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Neither of you talk the way you normally do... .

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Oh, really? Hehehe. It's no big deal. This is how I and Mandarava communicate.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Bina, I'll go to the warehouse and add the herbs I found.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Then take him with you. Don't forget to bring new cotton when you leave.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: New cotton! Bina, you are such a nice guy. I'll quickly put the herbs in the warehouse and retrieve cotton!
(Mandarava grabs the happy Mandrake and quickly flies in the direction of the Munchkin warehouse.)

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: … Whoa. It was hard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is how you treat spirits.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Hehe, I'm glad I found it before my mom found out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now can I hear what you said you would do?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Oh... . Did your tone change when you said you played with Letty all day yesterday?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Then I'll tell you. They say there's a rabbit monster living in the deepest part of the warehouse that runs amok every night.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A rabbit monster?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Yes, the rabbit monster.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: The warehouse is so large that the Munchkin clan often explores inside. But one day, the explorers got scared and ran out.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: When I asked him what he was surprised at, he fainted while saying something like a great devil rabbit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Great Demon Rabbit… ?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Uncle Runo went into the warehouse to find out, but it was so complicated that he couldn't find out anything.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Thanks to this, the man who is good at organizing was able to clean up the messy warehouse for a week. Meow.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: I'm not even sure if there is a real Great Demon Rabbit. That's why I called it a ghost story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: %s, you're not really trying to get in, are you?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Are you sure you want to go in?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I come in and check?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. It's still possible, but I definitely stopped it.
(Leticia, who was taking a walk in the village, spots Adventurer and Bina and runs over.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, Bina! What are you talking about?!

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Uh, Sister Letty? I told you about the rabbit monster in the warehouse. Adventurer said he wanted to go into the warehouse... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, can I come with you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don’t mind going with you, but… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Maybe Leticia will find her way.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: The warehouse is full of cats and there are also rabbits. I love it so much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Ah, that’s why you said you wanted to go. Okay, let's go together.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Nya… . I definitely stopped him. You can't go and get lost.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Bina, don’t worry too much. It'll be okay.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hehehe, Bina. If %s is okay with it, it's okay. Besides, it's in the village.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: If you say so... . Then, could you please pick this up for me when you come?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: It's a flower-shaped gem called a flower stone. I couldn't find it because I didn't know where my mom put it in the storage room.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll bring it to you when I find it.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Thank you. Meow. If you go in and feel like this is not the case, you should come out right away. Did you know?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hehe, I'll come out right away. Woohoo, it's a giant rabbit. Not a king rabbit, but a giant rabbit!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The warehouse was that teapot-shaped building. It looks small from the outside. Let’s go and check it out.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow… . Wow... .
(Leticia looks around and can't stop being amazed. The inside of the Munchkin warehouse is large and spacious, and every nook and cranny is filled with all kinds of items.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't believe it. This is a warehouse... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I understand why Bina told me not to go in. It's spacious, but why are there so many things? Wow… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of cabinets and storage cabinets are higher than the castle... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It's high, but there's no end in sight. Still, I can see the path clearly. Adventurer, let’s go over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As expected, it was a good thing I came with Leticia.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Isn’t the road with cat paw prints so cute? The pillar over there is a scratcher where a cat sharpens its claws... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Sylvia should see something cute like this too... .
“Pandora?”
(The moment the group is about to move forward, someone's voice is heard mentioning an unexpected person from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: … Where is it coming from? %s, do you know someone named Pandora?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That person… .
“I feel like I met you one day… . Is your name %s? %s… . okay. If it's that name... … .」
“I said it smelled like Pandora, and it turned out to be that human. “How dare me, how dare me!!”
(As the mysterious voice gets angry, the warehouse shakes. Then, the piled up items begin to fall to the floor one by one.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, I don't know who it is, but I wish they would leave the warehouse alone.
“Can’t you remember the topic that messed me up? A brave human being. Then I guess I'll have to cause an accident here. Now, decide. Either you die by my hands, or you die by Glinda’s hands.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you going to do... .
“You’ll have to come see me first. I won't let you get bored on my way there. “Enjoy a little entertainment!!”
(With those words, the shaking warehouse stops moving. However, another movement approaches at high speed, as if trying to tie up the %s group's feet.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Whoa whoa, Adventurer. Hey, look over there!!

lines.speaker: 트럼펫을 든 먼치킨
lines.text: Meow! Friends. It's an intruder who came to disrupt our ensemble!

lines.speaker: 유포니움을 든 먼치킨
lines.text: Meow! I can't forgive the person who came to ruin the performance of the century.

lines.speaker: 바순을 든 먼치킨
lines.text: Meow! I was playing for the crowd, but an uninvited guest came!!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, the Munchkin clan is in a very strange situation. We said hello and ate together for a few days, and even said he found the strange man’s jokes funny!!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Ugh, over there. The cooking spirit Yorijori comes running to us with a knife!!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I'm in a situation where I don't think I can talk with my head!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like the voice I heard earlier is controlling everyone... . Whoa, I can't help it. I have no choice but to go meet him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, follow me carefully.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yep!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Whoa. Looks like he's not following me anymore.
(Leticia wipes the sweat from her forehead and looks at Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There really is no end to it.
(The moment Adventurer looks around, a large shadow appears over the heads of the two people.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Uh… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, avoid!
Boom!
(Adventurer pushes Leticia away and blocks the attack of the being that falls forward.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The power is enormous... I keep getting pushed back.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wait, %s!!
(The moment Leticia tries to perform a kick attack on what appears to be an enemy, the large enemy steps back with a thumping sound.)
To come this far... . This time, I will kill you properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
(With the appearance of the enemy, the dust in the warehouse gradually disappears. And the huge enemy is slowly revealed through it.)
(A giant white rabbit doll is looking at the two with bloodshot red eyes.)
(She wears a pretty gothic dress in a black and white combination, a black rose eye patch, and a white mini hat, creating a strange atmosphere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A rampaging rabbit monster? No, it's a doll I think I've seen before... . It looks familiar... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: … Wow, that’s a big cotton ball.
Whoa, who calls you a cotton ball? Who is the rampaging rabbit monster? What's wrong with a rabbit!!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: If you have eyes, see for yourself. Bunny Bunny.
(Leticia points to the mirror hanging in the warehouse.)
I will curse Pandora... .
You put me like this and then disappear?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know me and Pandora? Who are you?
Who is it? I am Luceria... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Luceria? Luceria… . hmm… . iced coffee… ? That Luceria on the constellation cliff! But why are you here?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Then Bunny Bunny Luceria! What is your identity, doll?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Wow!! How dare you call me Bunny Bunny... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It's a rabbit doll that makes a squeaky sound every time it moves.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, it's dangerous, so get back. A doll with the soul of a dangerous witch... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow. Is it true?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Don’t call me a doll or a doll!! I'm alive!
(Giant rabbit doll - As Bunny Bunny Luceria struggles in anger, the magical powers that were in the Munchkin warehouse gather in one place.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: What, what happened?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, all the strong magic goes to Bunny Bunny... .

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Bunny Bunny I said no!! I'm Luceria!!
(With an angry shout, the warehouse continues to shake as the magic power is directed towards Bunny Bunny Luceria.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Bunny Bunny doll, okay. Stop it!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop! If things continue like this, the warehouse will collapse!

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: To the end, you call a doll Bunny Bunny... .

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: I will make you pay dearly for ignoring Luceria of Deception. Die!!
(With those words, the attack of the rabbit doll loaded with enormous magical power pours down on the %s party again.)
(Bunny Bunny Luceria, attacked by %s, is pushed back.)
(He tries to gather magical power again with his big doll hand and attack, but he just falls down.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, ha... . uh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait a minute... why is this sound coming all the way here?)

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Ugh… .
(Bunny Bunny Luceria raises the cotton ball sword and tries to swing it again, but falls forward.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Luceria?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: I still can do it. You can do it! Luceria of Deception cannot fall here.
(Leticia approaches and lifts up the fallen Bunny Bunny Luceria and helps her lean against the wall.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Huh. Ugh. I used up all the magic power in the warehouse and it looks like this. It's strange. Why are you like this?
(Bunny Bunny Luceria droops down and makes a crying sound, probably because she is feeling unfair and angry.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, Luceria. Calm down.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Ugh. Huh. If it were you, would you calm down? It's been like this inside the doll for over a hundred years.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: No! I can't calm down. How unfair it must be!

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: It would be easier if she died from the beginning like other witches. This is... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Where can you find such a word? So you killed another witch?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: It never happened because I was trying to kill Pandora.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why are you here? Weren't you with Pandora?
(When Pandora's name comes up, Bunny Bunny Luceria looks straight at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: It’s a long story… .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, please share your story. I'll be over there watching what the Munchkin clan is doing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Letty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hehe, what is it?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Haha. Then ask what you want to know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I ask….)

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Haha… . Now, the only witch on the Gendia continent is Pandora, right? In the past, there were many witches on the Gendia continent... .

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: At some point, a group of witches awakened and chased the night away, finding Pandora hiding in the shadows.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Agashura and a witch with abilities beyond humans. Pandora is bound to be attractive to those who have awakened as witches.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Because if she just killed Pandora, she could become the strongest witch in Gyendia.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Pandora wasn't interested in the witches' pastimes, and just didn't want to deal with them, so she created a trap to chase them away.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: The number of witches directly killed by Pandora is not large. Some of them fell into traps and died or were killed by others.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: As I did that, before I knew it, the only witches left in Gendia were me and Pandora.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: At that time, I didn't just hate Pandora, I despised it.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: My father taught Pandora a forbidden secret that he had not told me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Forbidden secret?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: If only I had that, I could truly become the best witch. I hated the fact that my dad told it to someone other than me.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: That's why I tried to kill Pandora and become the best. It looks like this now, but back then I was pretty good.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: But Pandora didn't kill him the day he was defeated. Instead, it held my soul as soon as it saw my body falling apart in the wrong way.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: That was the forbidden secret that my father knew. The soul can be moved to another place... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: He's just a crazy wizard.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: However, the soul ended up inside a doll that sealed hundreds of demonic beasts for experimentation. Pandora said there was no suitable place for the soul to enter... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Because the secret is disposable, it cannot be transferred to another place. ha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Oh, you said there were demons inside the dolls, right? I defeated it and completely destroyed its soul. Then one day, when I came to my senses, a thought occurred to me.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Fighting with a novice who seemed to have just started his adventure... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's my story. It seems like a human-shaped soul came out of the doll... .

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: I can't even remember my old self anymore. Oh, I don't know. I don't know why Pandora put me here. Why is it a warehouse shelf? There are many other places... .

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: When do you use it? What about putting it in storage because it’s useless? .

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: He said he would come and find a way to return it to its original state someday.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: They say we shouldn't fight anymore. Otherwise, you might get scolded by the village owner, the witch Glinda.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: So I said I would stay quiet, but then I brought Glinda with me.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: At that time, the doll was so old that I guess I shouldn't have said that it would be nice if it had a bigger body.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Glinda made a big rabbit doll and placed it in front of me. … No, why not make a human-like doll?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Pandora looked at it and said it was a very pretty doll and told her to go back to sleep. It's not your body.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Haha. What should I do? They say it will let you live like a human even if it doesn't look like its original form, so we'll have to wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Well, that's why I'm guarding the warehouse.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: %s Do you have anything to ask me other than the doll?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: For now, yes. Pandora left here and I met her... .

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: What is it? Where did you meet? They said they found a way?
(Bunny Bunny Luceria, who was drooping, jumps up as soon as she hears Pandora's name. But she loses strength and soon falls down.)

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Ugh… . I can't even move my body... . So where is Pandora now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Bunny Bunny Luceria about what happened in the Atlas Garden.)

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: I found a place where God's truth was, but there was no such thing as truth... . It means that while trying to take advantage of Daphne, you were tricked into signing a contract.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: I thought that, given Pandora's personality, she would find a way without killing the witch.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Haha… . How long do I have to stay inside this doll? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll do my best to find it. … … uh?
(At that moment, the lonely sound of string instruments that had stopped is mixed with the wind instruments of the Munchkin Music Band who came to their senses.)

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: As soon as the Munchkins come to their senses, they start playing again. eww… , It’s noisy. Huh?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: … … Was there a munchkin here that played the cello or something?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can you hear that sound?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: What is that sound... … … .

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: I suddenly feel sleepy... … . Why are you like this? I've never fallen asleep like a doll... .
Boom.
(Bunny Bunny Luceria, who was continuing to speak, stops moving. Then she falls down in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Luceria? Luceria!
(Bunny Bunny Luceria makes a snoring sound as if she is in a deep sleep.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wake up for a moment. Luceria, Luceria!
(No matter how much I shake it, Luceria doesn't move at all.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do? I think it's because of that music sound... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Oh, why is Bunny Bunny witch sleeping?
(Leticia finds something like a blanket somewhere and covers Luceria, the bunny bunny, who is lying down.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I'm not sure what's going on, but it's over for now, right? I also found the item that Bina talked about.
(Leticia gives a sparkling flower-shaped gem to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, this is it. Letty, thank you.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: What? But since there are witches like Glinda living in this town, wouldn’t witch Bunny Bunny be a secret?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, for now. And Bunny Bunny… . ah… . Meanwhile, I'm sleeping with my ears covered... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Clearly, Luceria heard the music like I did... If she fell asleep while listening to that music, I should too, but why...)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s. First, think about it while eating outside. The owner of the restaurant said that if you come late, there will be no soup.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Luceria will be okay... .

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Wow, Pandora. Lord, I'm going to kill you. Kuul… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Looks okay. Let's get out there, Letty.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Wow. I hate carrots. Don't put it in your hand. Kuul… .

steps.name: Secrets of the Warehouse (4)
steps.objective: Talk to [Vina] in “Dorothy Village” and go to [Glinda]. And after the conversation, report the quest to [Glinda].

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Nyaaaaa?! A witch's soul is in a giant running rabbit doll?
(Vina takes the flower stone and looks in disbelief.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: The witch was violent, but the doll was cute.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Nyang… . That looks cute. I want to go and see… .

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: I'll just have to watch it later. Even if you go in and out of the warehouse halfway, you have to call for rescue, and you're in the deepest part... .

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Well, the giant rabbit witch doll will come out when she wants to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm asleep right now, so I'll tell Glinda and meet her later.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. I will. Anyway, thank you for digging into the ghost story and finding the item I mentioned.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: While I was going to the warehouse, I packed the food prepared by the chef, chef, and teacher. Let’s go in and eat together.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: There's chocolate cream parfait, vongole pasta, and more. Anyway, there are a lot.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow. Great!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Bina.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, by the way, Raina is a cat beast, can I eat chocolate?...)

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: I know what %s’s face looks like! I'm fine. I ate a lot when I was young, but I didn't die! I'm still eating it right now. Hehehe, come on in. Meow.
(As Adventurer is about to enter the house following Vina and Leticia, the sight of a stranger passing through the village comes into view.)
What a crappy town. There is no need to come and take a look.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Who is that person...? I don't think he's from the village... Wait, horns? Wings? And he even has a tail...)
(The man passing by Adventurer stops and looks back.)
Ha, that's fun. Not only can they sense my presence, but they can clearly see me... . That's pretty good for a human.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
Well, who am I?
(The man sneers and shakes his head. Then the horns on his head become more prominent.)
Since you're destined to die anyway, it wouldn't hurt to at least tell me your name.
This is Tip, a descendant of the great black dragon.
(With those words, the wings on Tip’s waist spread wide.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...even the body scales, wings, and tail are all similar to dragons...)

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: It would be fun to cut you down with this.
(While Adventurer is watching Tip, Tip suddenly places two fingers on his head and closes his eyes.)

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Ah… … .

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: “Tipeta, I understand. Well, wait a moment.”
(Tip puts away his sword and smiles lightly at Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Unfortunately, I don't think now is the time. Phew.
(Tip sighs and jumps up in place. He then looks down at Adventurer below.)

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: You will soon find out. Adventurer %s.
(After finishing what he had to say, Tip flaps his wings vigorously and soars into the sky and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: From what you're saying, it sure looks like you're planning something. Uh, Glinda?
(Glynda runs in front of %s, who was looking at the sky.)
(Glinda checks the status of %s and puts the sword she was about to take out into the scabbard. Then, it goes back as if nothing had happened.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glinda? Glinda!
(Glynda raises her fan to cover her face as if she doesn't want to see the face of Adventurer who approaches her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glinda, why aren't you saying anything?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You saw that person earlier, right? That's why you came to where I am... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It's no big deal. It's none of your business. Cluck, cluck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They said you can only enter Dorothy's village with Glinda's permission, but that man also... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Nothing happened. Then that's it. Cluck, cluck. I'll take care of it, so don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. But now, Glinda’s condition is… .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It's just a cold symptom. I've taken the medicine, so I'll be fine.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Cluck, cluck. Then I'll take it as if I understand. You go back and hang out with Bina. hurry… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I will do that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't think I'll get any answer right now... Let's talk later. I don't know if it's possible...)
(Glynda gives up the conversation and looks at Adventurer in silence as she walks away.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: At that time, I thought the evil dragons were also sealed away, but I never thought they would appear like this... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Cluck, cluck… .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Let's check a little more first... … … .
